original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚埃博拉密切接触者增至53人，警察总监寻求200%退休金
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚联邦政府加强埃博拉应对，已识别53名密切接触者，并计划在设有指定入境口岸的州设立治疗中心。警察总监Olatunji Disu提议为退休警察发放200%的退休金。报道还提及，SDP总统候选人Adewole Adebayo警告不要以埃博拉疫情为由干扰2027年选举。该报道为单一来源的新闻综述。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚埃博拉密切接触者已识别53人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Federal Government is stepping up its Ebola response, with 53 contacts now identified and plans under way for treatment centres in states with designated ports of entry.

key_facts.fact: 警察总监提议为退休警察发放200%的退休金
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the Inspector-General of Police, Olatunji Disu, has proposed 200 per cent gratuity for retired police officers

key_facts.fact: SDP总统候选人警告不要以埃博拉疫情为由干扰2027年选举
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: SDP presidential candidate Adewole Adebayo has warned against using the Ebola outbreak as a reason to disrupt the 2027 elections

uncertainties: 埃博拉疫情的具体规模和传播范围尚未确认
该报道为单一来源的新闻综述，尚缺乏交叉验证
